name: axgraph
description: Build layered source-code graphs (TOML) for any project — query, validate, diagnose. Manual-graph discipline: humans in the loop, AI as accelerator.

pythonDependencies.notes: Python 3.11+ ships `tomllib` in stdlib. On 3.10, install `tomli` (`pip install tomli`) — graph_query.py and call_candidates.py auto-detect.
